options.text: Sweden Central. Linux App Service with the Node 24 LTS runtime. Private inbound access, outbound VNet integration, managed identity, HTTPS and TLS 1.2. FTP and basic publishing authentication are disabled.

Network, private DNS and monitoring references come from the platform environment. They are not developer inputs. This preview has no foundation bindings; enabling deployment requires a separately reviewed version.
